observations.analysis:
Johannes Sigil is not a historical figure, but a functional heteronym used within the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. The persona writes theoretical essays at the intersection of media theory, poetics, and symbolic engineering. Texts include: Symbolic Engineering (treating symbols as real-world techniques), Algorithmic Poetics (The Epic Without Hero), Operative Semiotics (retrocausal canons linking sigillographic texts with contemporary status governance).

Sources cited: Medium (THE EPIC WITHOUT HERO, MAGIC AS SYMBOLIC ENGINEERING), Academia.edu (The Seal Before the Name, THE EPIC WITHOUT HERO), PhilPapers (Plateau on Search, FROM ATOMISM).
